units: <cite ref="Pesachim 111b:8">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>ומיחזי כי ב׳ והדר בי כדא דכמכא</he> (v. comment.) and he (the shadow-demon) looks like a ladle turning in a vessel &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39a:3">Snh. 39ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>אותיבתה תותי ב׳</he> she placed it (the roast) under the grate (in the ashes); (Ar. <he>אותיבתיה קמיה בבִיחוּשֵׁיה</he> she placed it before him with the raked ashes clinging to it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 23:2">Yalk. Gen. 23</cite> <he>אותבי׳ תותי רגליה ב׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—[<he>בחשי</he>, quot. in Ar. fr.
Ab. Zar. (60ᵇ), תותי ב׳, read בֵּי שַׁחְיָא, arm-pit; v. Y. ib. II, 41ᵃ bot.]
